```{r Loop Anchor Gene Analysis, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
cat("\n=== LOOP ANCHOR GENE ANALYSIS ===\n\n")

loop_dir <- "R:/R_STIK/Hi-C/HiC_marta_Oct25/loops/intersected_loops"

loop_files <- list(
  EP1_specific = list(
    file = "EP1_specific_only_05_10kb_exp30kb_anchors.bed",
    type = "specific"
  ),
  Aro_specific = list(
    file = "ARO_specific_only_05_10kb_exp30kb_anchors.bed",
    type = "specific"
  ),
  REH_specific = list(
    file = "REH_specific_only_05_10kb_exp30kb_anchors.bed",
    type = "specific"
  ),
  shared_EP1_Aro = list(
    file = "shared_EP1_ARO_only_05_10kb_exp30kb_anchors.bed",
    type = "shared"
  ),
  shared_EP1_REH = list(
    file = "shared_EP1_REH_only_05_10kb_exp30kb_anchors.bed",
    type = "shared"
  ),
  shared_Aro_REH = list(
    file = "shared_ARO_REH_only_05_10kb_exp30kb_anchors.bed",
    type = "shared"
  ),
  shared_all3 = list(
    file = "shared_loops_all3_05_10kb_exp30kb_anchors.bed",
    type = "shared"
  )
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load BED files and intersect anchor coordinates directly with tss_gr
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
loop_data <- list()

for (loop_name in names(loop_files)) {
  file_path <- file.path(loop_dir, loop_files[[loop_name]]$file)
  if (file.exists(file_path)) {
    bed_data <- read.table(file_path, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    colnames(bed_data)[1:3] <- c("chr", "start", "end")
    
    anchors_gr <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(bed_data, seqnames.field = "chr")
    hits_tss   <- findOverlaps(anchors_gr, tss_gr)
    genes      <- unique(tss_gr$symbol[subjectHits(hits_tss)])
    genes      <- genes[!is.na(genes)]
    
    cat(paste0(loop_name, ": ", length(genes), " unique genes (from ",
               length(anchors_gr), " anchors)\n"))
    loop_data[[loop_name]] <- list(
      genes = genes,
      type  = loop_files[[loop_name]]$type
    )
  } else {
    cat(paste0("Warning: File not found - ", file_path, "\n"))
  }
}
cat("\n")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Build log2 normalized + batch-corrected + mean-centered matrix
#    (same pipeline as compartment analysis)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
mat_norm      <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)
mat_log2      <- log2(mat_norm + 1)

mat_corrected <- removeBatchEffect(
  mat_log2,
  batch  = colData(dds)$batch,
  design = model.matrix(~ condition, colData(dds))
)

mat_centered <- t(scale(t(mat_corrected), center = TRUE, scale = FALSE))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Long format + condition labels
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
counts_long <- as.data.frame(mat_centered) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_name") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = -gene_name,
    names_to  = "sample",
    values_to = "log2_centered"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    as.data.frame(colData(dds)) %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
      select(sample, condition) %>%
      mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("REH", "EP1", "Aro"))),
    by = "sample"
  )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Build combined data frame: one row per gene × sample × loop category
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
loop_counts_list <- list()

for (loop_name in names(loop_data)) {
  genes     <- loop_data[[loop_name]]$genes
  loop_type <- loop_data[[loop_name]]$type

  matched <- counts_long %>%
    filter(gene_name %in% genes) %>%
    mutate(
      loop_category = loop_name,
      loop_type     = loop_type
    )

  cat(paste0(loop_name, ": ", n_distinct(matched$gene_name), " genes matched in count matrix\n"))
  loop_counts_list[[loop_name]] <- matched
}
cat("\n")

loop_counts <- bind_rows(loop_counts_list) %>%
  mutate(
    loop_category = factor(loop_category, levels = names(loop_files)),
    loop_type     = factor(loop_type, levels = c("specific", "shared"))
  )

cat(paste0("Total observations: ", nrow(loop_counts), "\n\n"))

# After building loop_counts, add absolute value column
loop_counts <- bind_rows(loop_counts_list) %>%
  mutate(
    loop_category    = factor(loop_category, levels = names(loop_files)),
    loop_type        = factor(loop_type, levels = c("specific", "shared")),
  )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Summary statistics  (log2_centered)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
summary_stats <- loop_counts %>%
  group_by(loop_category, loop_type, condition) %>%
  summarise(
    n_genes    = n_distinct(gene_name),
    median_exp = median(log2_centered, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_exp   = mean(log2_centered,   na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_exp     = sd(log2_centered,     na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

cat("=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
print(summary_stats)
write.table(summary_stats,
            file.path(loops_dir, "loop_anchor_counts_summary.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Wilcoxon test per loop category: EP1 vs REH and Aro vs REH
#    On per-gene means per condition to avoid pseudo-replication
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

gene_means <- loop_counts %>%
  group_by(loop_category, loop_type, gene_name, condition) %>%
  summarise(mean_log2 = mean(log2_centered), .groups = "drop")   # <-- abs here

wilcox_results <- gene_means %>%
  group_by(loop_category, loop_type) %>%
  summarise(
    p_EP1_vs_REH = {
      x <- mean_log2[condition == "EP1"]
      y <- mean_log2[condition == "REH"]
      if (length(x) >= 3 & length(y) >= 3) wilcox.test(x, y)$p.value else NA_real_
    },
    p_Aro_vs_REH = {
      x <- mean_log2[condition == "Aro"]
      y <- mean_log2[condition == "REH"]
      if (length(x) >= 3 & length(y) >= 3) wilcox.test(x, y)$p.value else NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    padj_EP1_vs_REH = p.adjust(p_EP1_vs_REH, method = "BH"),
    padj_Aro_vs_REH = p.adjust(p_Aro_vs_REH, method = "BH"),
    sig_EP1         = sig_label(padj_EP1_vs_REH),
    sig_Aro         = sig_label(padj_Aro_vs_REH)
  )

cat("\n--- Wilcoxon results (BH-adjusted) ---\n")
print(wilcox_results)
write.table(wilcox_results,
            file.path(loops_dir, "wilcoxon_log2counts_loop_categories.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. y positions for significance labels
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
y_positions <- loop_counts %>%
  group_by(loop_category, condition) %>%
  summarise(y_max = max(log2_centered, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

bracket_df <- wilcox_results %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(sig_EP1, sig_Aro), names_to = "which", values_to = "sig") %>%
  filter(!is.na(sig)) %>%
  mutate(
    condition = factor(recode(which, "sig_EP1" = "EP1", "sig_Aro" = "Aro"),
                       levels = c("REH", "EP1", "Aro"))
  ) %>%
  left_join(y_positions, by = c("loop_category", "condition")) %>%
  mutate(y_pos = y_max * 1.08)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Color palettes
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
condition_colors <- c(
  "REH" = "#4393c3",
  "EP1" = "#d6604d",
  "Aro" = "#74c476"
)

loop_type_colors <- c(
  "specific" = "#E41A1C",
  "shared"   = "#377EB8"
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot 1 — Boxplot
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
p1 <- ggplot(
  loop_counts,
  aes(x = condition, y = log2_centered, fill = condition)   # <-- abs here
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.size  = 0.4,
    outlier.alpha = 0.3,
    alpha         = 0.7,
    linewidth     = 0.4
  ) +
  # geom_hline removed — zero baseline not meaningful for absolute values
  {if (nrow(bracket_df) > 0)
    geom_text(
      data        = bracket_df,
      aes(x       = condition, y = y_pos, label = sig),
      size        = 3,
      fontface    = "bold",
      color       = "gray20",
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    )
  } +
  scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors) +
  facet_wrap(~ loop_category, nrow = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.title       = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 13),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "black"),
    legend.position  = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  xlab("Condition") +
  ylab("Log2 normalized counts (batch-corrected, mean-centered)") +
  labs(title = "Gene expression at loop anchors per loop category")

print(p1)
ggsave(file.path(loops_dir, "loop_anchor_counts_boxplot_by_category.pdf"),
       p1, width = 16, height = 6)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot 2 — Violin: specific vs shared
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
gene_means_type <- gene_means %>%
  group_by(loop_type, gene_name, condition) %>%
  summarise(mean_log2 = mean(mean_log2), .groups = "drop")

wilcox_type <- gene_means_type %>%
  group_by(loop_type) %>%
  summarise(
    p_EP1_vs_REH = wilcox.test(
      mean_log2[condition == "EP1"],
      mean_log2[condition == "REH"]
    )$p.value,
    p_Aro_vs_REH = wilcox.test(
      mean_log2[condition == "Aro"],
      mean_log2[condition == "REH"]
    )$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sig_EP1 = sig_label(p.adjust(p_EP1_vs_REH, method = "BH")),
    sig_Aro = sig_label(p.adjust(p_Aro_vs_REH, method = "BH"))
  )

y_type <- gene_means_type %>%
  group_by(loop_type, condition) %>%
  summarise(y_max = max(mean_log2, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

bracket_type <- wilcox_type %>%
  pivot_longer(c(sig_EP1, sig_Aro), names_to = "which", values_to = "sig") %>%
  filter(!is.na(sig)) %>%
  mutate(
    condition = factor(recode(which, "sig_EP1" = "EP1", "sig_Aro" = "Aro"),
                       levels = c("REH", "EP1", "Aro"))
  ) %>%
  left_join(y_type, by = c("loop_type", "condition")) %>%
  mutate(y_pos = y_max * 1.08)

p2 <- ggplot(
  gene_means_type,
  aes(x = condition, y = mean_log2, fill = condition)
) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.2, size = 0.6) +
  {if (nrow(bracket_type) > 0)
    geom_text(
      data        = bracket_type,
      aes(x       = condition, y = y_pos, label = sig),
      size        = 3,
      fontface    = "bold",
      color       = "gray20",
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    )
  } +
  scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors) +
  facet_wrap(~ loop_type, nrow = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "none",
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 11),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "black"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  xlab("Condition") +
  ylab("Log2 normalized counts (batch-corrected, mean-centered)") +
  labs(title = "Expression at loop anchors: specific vs shared")

print(p2)
ggsave(file.path(loops_dir, "loop_anchor_counts_violin_specific_vs_shared.pdf"),
       p2, width = 8, height = 6)
```

```{r Loop vs Random Genome Comparison, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
cat("\n=== LOOP ANCHORS vs RANDOM GENOME REGIONS ===\n\n")

library(GenomicRanges)

# ── 1. Collapse ALL loop anchor genes into one set ────────────────────────────
all_loop_genes <- unique(unlist(lapply(loop_data, function(x) x$genes)))
cat(paste0("Total unique genes at any loop anchor: ", length(all_loop_genes), "\n"))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Read random regions from BED file
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
random_bed_path <- "R:/R_STIK/Hi-C/HiC_marta_Oct25/loops/intersected_loops/chip_coverage/random_regions_labeled_sorted.bed"
stopifnot(file.exists(random_bed_path))

random_bed <- read.table(random_bed_path, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
cat(paste0("Loaded ", nrow(random_bed), " random regions from BED file\n"))

random_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = random_bed[[1]],
  ranges   = IRanges(start = random_bed[[2]] + 1L,   # BED is 0-based
                     end   = random_bed[[3]])
)
cat(paste0("Random GRanges object: ", length(random_gr), " intervals\n\n"))


# ── 3. Count total unique anchor intervals across all loop files ──────────────
n_loops_to_sample <- 0
for (loop_name in names(loop_files)) {
  file_path <- file.path(loop_dir, loop_files[[loop_name]]$file)
  if (file.exists(file_path)) {
    bed <- read.table(file_path, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    n_loops_to_sample <- n_loops_to_sample + nrow(unique(bed[, 1:3]))
  }
}
cat(paste0("Total unique loop anchor intervals: ", n_loops_to_sample, "\n"))

# ── 4. Map genes to random regions (exclude any already in loop set) ──────────
hits_random  <- findOverlaps(random_gr, tss_gr)
random_genes <- unique(tss_gr$symbol[subjectHits(hits_random)])
random_genes <- random_genes[!is.na(random_genes)]
random_genes <- random_genes[!random_genes %in% all_loop_genes]
cat(paste0("Unique genes in random regions (not in loops): ", length(random_genes), "\n\n"))

# ── 5. Build long-format data matching the loop anchor chunk style ────────────
loop_long <- counts_long %>%
  filter(gene_name %in% all_loop_genes) %>%
  mutate(group = "Loop anchors")

random_long <- counts_long %>%
  filter(gene_name %in% random_genes) %>%
  mutate(group = "Random regions")

compare_long <- bind_rows(loop_long, random_long) %>%
  mutate(
    group     = factor(group, levels = c("Loop anchors", "Random regions")),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("REH", "EP1", "Aro"))
  )

cat(paste0("Loop anchor genes matched in matrix:   ",
           n_distinct(loop_long$gene_name), "\n"))
cat(paste0("Random region genes matched in matrix: ",
           n_distinct(random_long$gene_name), "\n\n"))

# ── 6. Per-gene means per condition (avoid pseudo-replication) ────────────────
gene_means_comp <- compare_long %>%
  group_by(group, gene_name, condition) %>%
  summarise(mean_log2 = mean(log2_centered, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# ── 7. Wilcoxon tests: Loop anchors vs Random regions, within each condition ──
wilcox_comp <- gene_means_comp %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(
    p_loop_vs_random = {
      x <- mean_log2[group == "Loop anchors"]
      y <- mean_log2[group == "Random regions"]
      if (length(x) >= 3 & length(y) >= 3) wilcox.test(x, y)$p.value else NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    padj_loop_vs_random = p.adjust(p_loop_vs_random, method = "BH"),
    sig                 = sig_label(padj_loop_vs_random)
  )

cat("=== Wilcoxon tests: EP1 vs REH and Aro vs REH (BH-adjusted) ===\n")
print(wilcox_comp)
write.table(wilcox_comp,
            file.path(loops_dir, "wilcoxon_loop_vs_random_by_condition.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

# ── 8. Significance label y-positions ────────────────────────────────────────
y_positions_comp <- compare_long %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(y_max = max(log2_centered, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

bracket_comp <- wilcox_comp %>%
  filter(!is.na(sig)) %>%
  left_join(y_positions_comp, by = "condition") %>%
  mutate(
    y_pos     = y_max * 1.08,
    condition = factor(condition, levels = c("REH", "EP1", "Aro"))
  )

# ── 9. Summary stats ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
summary_comp <- gene_means_comp %>%
  group_by(group, condition) %>%
  summarise(
    n_genes = n_distinct(gene_name),
    mean    = round(mean(mean_log2,   na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    median  = round(median(mean_log2, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    sd      = round(sd(mean_log2,     na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
cat("\n=== Summary statistics ===\n")
print(summary_comp)
write.table(summary_comp,
            file.path(loops_dir, "loop_vs_random_summary_stats.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

# ── 10. Violin + Boxplot: group on x-axis, faceted by condition ──────────────
p_box <- ggplot(
  compare_long,
  aes(x = group, y = log2_centered, fill = group)
) +
  geom_violin(
    alpha     = 0.4,
    linewidth = 0.3,
    trim      = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width         = 0.25,
    outlier.size  = 0.4,
    outlier.alpha = 0.3,
    alpha         = 0.8,
    linewidth     = 0.4
  ) +
  # significance brackets spanning the two groups
  {if (nrow(bracket_comp) > 0)
    ggsignif::geom_signif(
      data        = bracket_comp,
      aes(
        xmin        = 1,
        xmax        = 2,
        annotations = sig,
        y_position  = y_pos
      ),
      manual      = TRUE,
      tip_length  = 0.01,
      textsize    = 5,
      fontface    = "bold",
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    )
  } +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Loop anchors" = "#4E79A7", "Random regions" = "#F28E2B")
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ condition, nrow = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title       = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "black"),
    legend.position  = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  xlab("Region type") +
  ylab("Log2 normalized counts (batch-corrected, mean-centred)") +
  labs(
    title    = "Gene expression: loop anchors vs random 30 kb regions",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Loop anchor genes: ", n_distinct(loop_long$gene_name),
      "  |  Random region genes: ", n_distinct(random_long$gene_name)
    )
  )

print(p_box)
ggsave(file.path(loops_dir, "loop_vs_random_violin_boxplot.pdf"),
       p_box, width = 9, height = 7)

# ── 11. Per-category + Random regions facet (replicates loop anchor style) ────

# Build per-loop-category long data
loop_category_long <- counts_long %>%
  filter(gene_name %in% all_loop_genes) %>%
  left_join(
    bind_rows(lapply(names(loop_data), function(cat) {
      data.frame(gene_name = loop_data[[cat]]$genes,
                 facet_group = cat,
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    })),
    by = "gene_name",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  mutate(facet_group = factor(facet_group, levels = names(loop_data)))

# Random regions get their own facet at the end
random_category_long <- random_long %>%
  mutate(facet_group = factor("Random regions"))

combined_long <- bind_rows(loop_category_long, random_category_long) %>%
  mutate(
    facet_group = factor(facet_group,
                         levels = c(levels(loop_category_long$facet_group),
                                    "Random regions")),
    condition   = factor(condition, levels = c("REH", "EP1", "Aro"))
  )

# ── Wilcoxon: EP1 vs REH and Aro vs REH, within each facet group ─────────────
gene_means_cat <- combined_long %>%
  group_by(facet_group, gene_name, condition) %>%
  summarise(mean_log2 = mean(log2_centered, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

wilcox_cat <- gene_means_cat %>%
  group_by(facet_group) %>%
  summarise(
    p_EP1_vs_REH = {
      x <- mean_log2[condition == "EP1"]
      y <- mean_log2[condition == "REH"]
      if (length(x) >= 3 & length(y) >= 3) wilcox.test(x, y)$p.value else NA_real_
    },
    p_Aro_vs_REH = {
      x <- mean_log2[condition == "Aro"]
      y <- mean_log2[condition == "REH"]
      if (length(x) >= 3 & length(y) >= 3) wilcox.test(x, y)$p.value else NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    padj_EP1_vs_REH = p.adjust(p_EP1_vs_REH, method = "BH"),
    padj_Aro_vs_REH = p.adjust(p_Aro_vs_REH, method = "BH"),
    sig_EP1         = sig_label(padj_EP1_vs_REH),
    sig_Aro         = sig_label(padj_Aro_vs_REH)
  )

cat("=== Wilcoxon tests per category + random (BH-adjusted) ===\n")
print(wilcox_cat)
write.table(wilcox_cat,
            file.path(loops_dir, "wilcoxon_by_category_and_random.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

# ── Significance label positions ──────────────────────────────────────────────
y_pos_cat <- combined_long %>%
  group_by(facet_group, condition) %>%
  summarise(y_max = max(log2_centered, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

bracket_cat <- wilcox_cat %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(sig_EP1, sig_Aro),
               names_to = "which", values_to = "sig") %>%
  filter(!is.na(sig)) %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(recode(which, "sig_EP1" = "EP1", "sig_Aro" = "Aro"),
                            levels = c("REH", "EP1", "Aro"))) %>%
  left_join(y_pos_cat, by = c("facet_group", "condition")) %>%
  mutate(y_pos = y_max * 1.08)

# ── Plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_cat <- ggplot(
  combined_long,
  aes(x = condition, y = log2_centered, fill = condition)
) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.3, trim = FALSE) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width         = 0.25,
    outlier.size  = 0.4,
    outlier.alpha = 0.3,
    alpha         = 0.8,
    linewidth     = 0.4
  ) +
  {if (nrow(bracket_cat) > 0)
    geom_text(
      data        = bracket_cat,
      aes(x = condition, y = y_pos, label = sig),
      size        = 3,
      fontface    = "bold",
      color       = "gray20",
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    )
  } +
  scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors) +
  facet_wrap(~ facet_group, nrow = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title       = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 13),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "black"),
    legend.position  = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  xlab("Condition") +
  ylab("Log2 normalized counts (batch-corrected, mean-centred)") +
  labs(
    title    = "Gene expression at loop anchors per category + random regions",
    subtitle = paste0("Random region genes: ", n_distinct(random_long$gene_name))
  )

print(p_cat)
ggsave(file.path(loops_dir, "loop_category_vs_random_violin_boxplot.pdf"),
       p_cat, width = 16, height = 7)

cat("\n=== Per-category + random analysis complete ===\n")
cat("\n=== Loop vs Random analysis complete — plots saved to Loops/ ===\n")
```

```{r Compartment intersection}
data <- "R:/R_STIK/Hi-C/HiC_marta_Oct25/cscore/Comp_Analysis/files/cs_REH_merge.tab"
# data <- "/ijc/LABS/STIK/RAW/Hi-C/HiC_marta_Oct25/cscore/Comp_Analysis/files/cs_REH_merge.tab"

cs_REH_merge <- read.table(data,
                            sep       = "\t",
                            header    = TRUE,
                            stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

switching_levels <- c(
  "A_A_A", "B_B_B",
  "B_A_A", "B_B_A",
  "A_B_B", "A_A_B",
  "A_B_A", "B_A_B"
)

cs_REH_merge$switching <- factor(cs_REH_merge$switching, levels = switching_levels)

# ============================================================================
# INTERSECTION: Dynamic compartments × normalized counts
# ============================================================================

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Build GRanges from ALL compartment bins (dynamic + stable)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
all_bins <- cs_REH_merge   # no filtering — keep A_A_A and B_B_B

bins_gr <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(
  all_bins %>% select(chr, start, end, switching),
  seqnames.field     = "chr",
  keep.extra.columns = TRUE
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Overlap bins → genes
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
hits <- findOverlaps(bins_gr, genes_gr)

bin_gene_map <- data.frame(
  switching = bins_gr$switching[queryHits(hits)],
  gene_name = genes_gr$gene_name[subjectHits(hits)]
) %>% distinct()

cat("Unique genes overlapping all bins:", n_distinct(bin_gene_map$gene_name), "\n")
cat("Classes present:", paste(levels(droplevels(bin_gene_map$switching)), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Build log2 normalized + batch-corrected + mean-centered matrix
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
mat_norm      <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)
mat_log2      <- log2(mat_norm + 1)

mat_corrected <- removeBatchEffect(
  mat_log2,
  batch  = colData(dds)$batch,
  design = model.matrix(~ condition, colData(dds))
)

mat_centered <- t(scale(t(mat_corrected), center = TRUE, scale = FALSE))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Long format + condition labels
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
counts_long <- as.data.frame(mat_centered) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_name") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = -gene_name,
    names_to  = "sample",
    values_to = "log2_centered"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    as.data.frame(colData(dds)) %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
      select(sample, condition) %>%
      mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("REH", "EP1", "Aro"))),
    by = "sample"
  )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Join with bin_gene_map → ALL compartment classes including A_A_A and B_B_B
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
all_classes <- c("A_A_A", "B_B_B", "B_A_A", "B_B_A", "B_A_B", "A_B_B", "A_A_B", "A_B_A")

counts_comp <- bin_gene_map %>%
  inner_join(counts_long, by = "gene_name") %>%
  filter(switching %in% all_classes) %>%
  mutate(switching = factor(switching, levels = all_classes))

cat("Genes in all compartment bins with count data:", n_distinct(counts_comp$gene_name), "\n")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Wilcoxon test per switching class: EP1 vs REH and Aro vs REH
#    On per-gene means per condition to avoid pseudo-replication
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
gene_means <- counts_comp %>%
  group_by(switching, gene_name, condition) %>%
  summarise(mean_log2 = mean(log2_centered), .groups = "drop")

wilcox_results <- gene_means %>%
  group_by(switching) %>%
  summarise(
    p_EP1_vs_REH = {
      x <- mean_log2[condition == "EP1"]
      y <- mean_log2[condition == "REH"]
      if (length(x) >= 3 & length(y) >= 3) wilcox.test(x, y)$p.value else NA_real_
    },
    p_Aro_vs_REH = {
      x <- mean_log2[condition == "Aro"]
      y <- mean_log2[condition == "REH"]
      if (length(x) >= 3 & length(y) >= 3) wilcox.test(x, y)$p.value else NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    padj_EP1_vs_REH = p.adjust(p_EP1_vs_REH, method = "BH"),
    padj_Aro_vs_REH = p.adjust(p_Aro_vs_REH, method = "BH"),
    sig_EP1         = sig_label(padj_EP1_vs_REH),
    sig_Aro         = sig_label(padj_Aro_vs_REH)
  )

cat("\n--- Wilcoxon results (BH-adjusted) ---\n")
print(wilcox_results)
write.table(wilcox_results,
            file.path(comp_dir, "wilcoxon_log2counts_all_classes.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Significance labels positioned above EP1 and Aro per facet
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
y_positions <- counts_comp %>%
  group_by(switching, condition) %>%
  summarise(y_max = max(log2_centered, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

bracket_df <- wilcox_results %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(sig_EP1, sig_Aro), names_to = "which", values_to = "sig") %>%
  filter(!is.na(sig)) %>%
  mutate(
    condition = factor(recode(which, "sig_EP1" = "EP1", "sig_Aro" = "Aro"),
                       levels = c("REH", "EP1", "Aro"))
  ) %>%
  left_join(y_positions, by = c("switching", "condition")) %>%
  mutate(y_pos = y_max * 1.08)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Boxplot: condition on x-axis, faceted by switching class (all 8 classes)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
switching_colors <- c(
  "A_A_A" = "#1a1a1a",   # stable A → dark
  "B_B_B" = "#bdbdbd",   # stable B → light grey
  "B_A_A" = "#d95f02",
  "B_A_B" = "#fdae61",
  "B_B_A" = "#fee08b",
  "A_B_B" = "#542788",
  "A_B_A" = "#8073ac",
  "A_A_B" = "#b2abd2"
)

counts_boxplot <- ggplot(
  counts_comp,
  aes(x = condition, y = log2_centered, fill = switching)
) +
  geom_violin(
    alpha     = 0.4,
    linewidth = 0.3,
    trim      = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width         = 0.25,
    outlier.size  = 0.4,
    outlier.alpha = 0.3,
    alpha         = 0.8,
    linewidth     = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype   = "dashed",
    color      = "gray30",
    linewidth  = 0.4
  ) +
  {if (nrow(bracket_df) > 0)
    geom_text(
      data        = bracket_df,
      aes(x       = condition, y = y_pos, label = sig),
      size        = 3,
      fontface    = "bold",
      color       = "gray20",
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    )
  } +
  scale_fill_manual(values = switching_colors) +
  facet_wrap(~ switching, nrow = 2, ncol = 4) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.title       = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 13),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "black"),
    legend.position  = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  xlab("Condition") +
  ylab("Log2 normalized counts (batch-corrected, mean-centered)") +
  labs(title = "Gene expression across all compartment classes")

print(counts_boxplot)
ggsave(
  file.path(comp_dir, "Log2counts_boxplot_all_classes.pdf"),
  plot   = counts_boxplot,
  width  = 16,
  height = 10
)
```

```{r Compartment enrichment}
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Enrichment: switching class × contrast × direction (UP / DOWN)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

dbs <- c("GO_Biological_Process_2023",
         "KEGG_2021_Human",
         "WikiPathway_2023_Human",
         "Reactome_2022",
         "MSigDB_Hallmark_2020")

# Build comp_rnaseq: DEG results joined with compartment switching class
comp_rnaseq <- bind_rows(all_results) %>%
  rename(gene_name = gene) %>%
  inner_join(
    bin_gene_map %>% rename(gene_name = gene_name),  # already named gene_name
    by = "gene_name"
  )

# Filter DEGs passing thresholds — keep direction (diffexpressed)
deg_filtered <- comp_rnaseq %>%
  filter(
    padj < 0.05,
    abs(log2FoldChange) > 1,
    diffexpressed %in% c("UP", "DOWN")
  ) %>%
  distinct(gene_name, switching, contrast, diffexpressed)

cat("DEGs per switching class, contrast, and direction:\n")
print(table(deg_filtered$switching, deg_filtered$contrast, deg_filtered$diffexpressed))

# Build gene lists: one per switching × contrast × direction
comp_gene_lists <- deg_filtered %>%
  group_by(switching, contrast, diffexpressed) %>%
  summarise(genes = list(unique(gene_name)), .groups = "drop")

cat("\nGene list sizes:\n")
print(data.frame(
  switching    = comp_gene_lists$switching,
  contrast     = comp_gene_lists$contrast,
  direction    = comp_gene_lists$diffexpressed,
  n_genes      = sapply(comp_gene_lists$genes, length)
))

comp_enrichr_results <- list()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(comp_gene_lists))) {

  sw_class  <- as.character(comp_gene_lists$switching[i])
  contrast  <- comp_gene_lists$contrast[i]
  direction <- comp_gene_lists$diffexpressed[i]
  gene_vec  <- comp_gene_lists$genes[[i]]
  list_key  <- paste0(sw_class, "_", contrast, "_", direction)

  cat("\n=== Switching:", sw_class,
      "| Contrast:", contrast,
      "| Direction:", direction,
      "| Genes:", length(gene_vec), "===\n")

  if (length(gene_vec) < 5 || !websiteLive) {
    cat("  Skipping – too few genes or enrichR offline\n")
    next
  }

  enriched <- enrichr(gene_vec, dbs)
  comp_enrichr_results[[list_key]] <- enriched

  for (db_idx in seq_along(dbs)) {
    db_name <- dbs[db_idx]

    if (is.null(enriched[[db_idx]]) || nrow(enriched[[db_idx]]) == 0) next

    enriched_processed <- process_enrichr_db(enriched[[db_idx]])
    sig_terms          <- subset(enriched_processed, Adjusted.P.value < 0.05)

    if (nrow(sig_terms) == 0) {
      cat("  No significant terms:", db_name, "\n")
      next
    }

    # Save TSV
    save_enrichr_genelists(
      sig_terms,
      prefix  = paste0(sw_class, "_", contrast, "_", direction, "_", db_name),
      out_dir = comp_enrichr_dir
    )

    # Plot
    p <- plot_enrichr(
      sig_terms,
      title_str = paste0(db_name, "\n", sw_class,
                         " | ", contrast, " | ", direction),
      xlab_str  = paste0(db_name, " Terms")
    )
    print(p)

    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(comp_enrichr_dir,
                           paste0("enrichR_", db_name, "_",
                                  sw_class, "_", contrast, "_", direction, ".pdf")),
      plot   = p,
      width  = 10,
      height = 7
    )

    cat("  Saved:", db_name, direction, "\n")
  }
}

cat("\n=== Compartment enrichR analysis complete ===\n")
```

```{r TAD intersection}

cat("\n=== TAD BOUNDARY GENE ANALYSIS (ONLY REH vs EP1 Comparison) ===\n\n")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load TAD boundary BED files + random regions
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
tad_dir    <- "R:/R_STIK/Hi-C/HiC_marta_Oct25/TADs/EP1_vs_REH_comparison"
random_dir <- "R:/R_STIK/Hi-C/HiC_marta_Oct25/TADs/EP1_vs_REH_comparison/atac_coverage"

tad_files <- list(
  shared_all_three      = list(file = file.path(tad_dir, "shared_boundaries_filtered.bed"),                             label = "shared"),
  specific_REH          = list(file = file.path(tad_dir, "unique_to_REH_boundaries.bed"),                              label = "specific_REH"),
  specific_EP1          = list(file = file.path(tad_dir, "unique_to_HiC-REH-EP1_boundaries.bed"),                      label = "specific_EP1")
)

tad_gr_list <- list()

for (tad_name in names(tad_files)) {
  bed <- read.table(
    tad_files[[tad_name]]$file,
    header = FALSE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  colnames(bed)[1:3] <- c("chr", "start", "end")

  gr <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(
    bed %>% mutate(tad_category = tad_files[[tad_name]]$label),
    seqnames.field     = "chr",
    keep.extra.columns = TRUE
  )
  tad_gr_list[[tad_name]] <- gr
  cat(paste0(tad_files[[tad_name]]$label, ": ", length(gr), " boundaries\n"))
}

# Load random regions
random_bed <- read.table(
  file.path(random_dir, "random_regions_labeled_sorted.bed"),
  header = FALSE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  col.names = c("chr", "start", "end", "boundary_class")
)

random_gr <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(
  random_bed %>% mutate(tad_category = "random"),
  seqnames.field     = "chr",
  keep.extra.columns = TRUE
)
cat(paste0("random: ", length(random_gr), " regions\n"))

tad_gr_all <- do.call(c, c(unname(tad_gr_list), list(random_gr)))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Overlap TAD boundaries + random regions → gene symbols
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
hits_tad <- findOverlaps(tad_gr_all, genes_gr)

tad_gene_map <- data.frame(
  tad_category = tad_gr_all$tad_category[queryHits(hits_tad)],
  gene_name    = genes_gr$gene_name[subjectHits(hits_tad)]
) %>% distinct()

cat("\nUnique genes per TAD boundary category:\n")
print(table(tad_gene_map$tad_category))
cat("\n")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Build log2 normalized + batch-corrected + mean-centered matrix
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
mat_norm_tad      <- counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)
mat_log2_tad      <- log2(mat_norm_tad + 1)

mat_corrected_tad <- removeBatchEffect(
  mat_log2_tad,
  batch  = colData(dds)$batch,
  design = model.matrix(~ condition, colData(dds))
)

mat_centered_tad <- t(scale(t(mat_corrected_tad), center = TRUE, scale = FALSE))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Long format + condition labels 
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
counts_long_tad <- as.data.frame(mat_centered_tad) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_name") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = -gene_name,
    names_to  = "sample",
    values_to = "log2_centered"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    as.data.frame(colData(dds)) %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
      select(sample, condition) %>%
      mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("REH", "EP1"))),
    by = "sample"
  )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Join TAD gene map with expression data
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
tad_category_levels <- c(
  "shared",
  "specific_REH", "specific_EP1",
  "random"
)

counts_tad <- tad_gene_map %>%
  inner_join(counts_long_tad, by = "gene_name") %>%
  filter(condition %in% c("REH", "EP1")) %>%
  mutate(tad_category = factor(tad_category, levels = tad_category_levels))

cat("Genes per condition × TAD category matched in expression matrix:\n")
print(counts_tad %>% distinct(tad_category, gene_name) %>% dplyr::count(tad_category))
cat(paste0("\nTotal observations: ", nrow(counts_tad), "\n\n"))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Summary statistics
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
summary_stats_tad <- counts_tad %>%
  group_by(tad_category, condition) %>%
  summarise(
    n_genes    = n_distinct(gene_name),
    median_exp = median(log2_centered, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_exp   = mean(log2_centered,   na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_exp     = sd(log2_centered,     na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

cat("=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
print(summary_stats_tad)
write.table(summary_stats_tad,
            file.path(tad_out_dir, "tad_boundary_counts_summary.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Wilcoxon: each TAD category vs random, per condition (BH-adjusted)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

gene_means_tad <- counts_tad %>%
  group_by(tad_category, gene_name, condition) %>%
  summarise(mean_log2 = mean(log2_centered), .groups = "drop")

tad_cats_to_test <- c(
  "shared", "specific_REH", "specific_EP1"
)

wilcox_tad <- gene_means_tad %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    rand_vals <- .x$mean_log2[.x$tad_category == "random"]
    results <- lapply(tad_cats_to_test, function(cat) {
      test_vals <- .x$mean_log2[.x$tad_category == cat]
      p <- if (length(test_vals) >= 3 & length(rand_vals) >= 3) {
        wilcox.test(test_vals, rand_vals)$p.value
      } else NA_real_
      data.frame(tad_category = cat, p_value = p)
    })
    do.call(rbind, results)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  mutate(
    padj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    sig  = sig_label(padj)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("\n--- Wilcoxon: each TAD category vs random (BH-adjusted per condition) ---\n")
print(wilcox_tad)
write.table(wilcox_tad,
            file.path(tad_out_dir, "wilcoxon_tad_vs_random.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Significance label y-positions
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
y_positions_tad <- counts_tad %>%
  group_by(condition, tad_category) %>%
  summarise(y_max = max(log2_centered, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

bracket_tad <- wilcox_tad %>%
  filter(!is.na(sig)) %>%
  mutate(tad_category = factor(tad_category, levels = tad_category_levels)) %>%
  left_join(y_positions_tad, by = c("condition", "tad_category")) %>%
  mutate(y_pos = y_max * 1.08)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Color palette for 8 categories
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
tad_colors <- c(
  "shared"     = "#525252",   # dark gray  — shared by everyone
  "specific_REH"   = "#4393c3",   # blue       — REH only
  "specific_EP1"   = "#d6604d",   # red-orange — EP1 only
  "random"         = "#b8b8b8"    # light gray — background control
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Plot — faceted by condition (3 panels)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Random median per condition for reference line
random_medians <- counts_tad %>%
  filter(tad_category == "random") %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(rand_med = median(log2_centered, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

p_tad <- ggplot(
  counts_tad,
  aes(x = tad_category, y = log2_centered, fill = tad_category)
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.size  = 0.3,
    outlier.alpha = 0.2,
    alpha         = 0.75,
    linewidth     = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    data      = random_medians,
    aes(yintercept = rand_med),
    linetype  = "dashed",
    color     = "gray40",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  {if (nrow(bracket_tad) > 0)
    geom_text(
      data        = bracket_tad,
      aes(x = tad_category, y = y_pos, label = sig),
      size        = 3,
      fontface    = "bold",
      color       = "gray20",
      inherit.aes = FALSE
    )
  } +
  scale_fill_manual(values = tad_colors) +
  facet_wrap(~ condition, nrow = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.title       = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, color = "gray40"),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "black"),
    legend.position  = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  xlab("TAD boundary category") +
  ylab("Log2 normalized counts (batch-corrected, mean-centered)") +
  labs(
    title    = "Gene expression at TAD boundaries",
    subtitle = "Significance vs random (Wilcoxon, BH-adjusted) — dashed line = random median per condition"
  )

print(p_tad)
ggsave(file.path(tad_out_dir, "tad_boundary_counts_boxplot.pdf"),
       p_tad, width = 16, height = 7)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. DEG overlap — now using condition-specific DEGs
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n=== DEG OVERLAP WITH TAD BOUNDARIES ===\n\n")

all_deg_genes_tad <- all_results[["EP1_vs_REH"]] %>%   # <- use your actual list name
  filter(diffexpressed != "NO") %>%
  pull(gene)

deg_tad_overlap <- tad_gene_map %>%
  mutate(is_DEG = gene_name %in% all_deg_genes_tad) %>%
  group_by(tad_category) %>%
  summarise(
    n_genes_total = n_distinct(gene_name),
    n_DEGs        = n_distinct(gene_name[is_DEG]),
    pct_DEGs      = round(n_distinct(gene_name[is_DEG]) / n_distinct(gene_name) * 100, 2),
    .groups       = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(tad_category = factor(tad_category, levels = tad_category_levels))

cat("DEG enrichment per TAD boundary category:\n")
print(deg_tad_overlap)
write.table(deg_tad_overlap,
            file.path(tad_out_dir, "tad_boundary_DEG_overlap.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

# Pairwise Fisher: each TAD category vs random
contingency_tad <- matrix(
  c(deg_tad_overlap$n_DEGs,
    deg_tad_overlap$n_genes_total - deg_tad_overlap$n_DEGs),
  nrow = nrow(deg_tad_overlap),
  dimnames = list(
    as.character(deg_tad_overlap$tad_category),
    c("DEG", "not_DEG")
  )
)

cat("\nPairwise Fisher — each TAD category vs random:\n")
random_row <- contingency_tad["random", ]
for (cat_name in tad_cats_to_test) {
  if (cat_name %in% rownames(contingency_tad)) {
    ct <- rbind(contingency_tad[cat_name, ], random_row)
    ft <- fisher.test(ct)
    cat(sprintf("  %s vs random: OR = %.2f, p = %.4f\n", cat_name, ft$estimate, ft$p.value))
  }
}

# Bar plot of DEG percentages
p_deg_tad <- ggplot(
  deg_tad_overlap,
  aes(x = tad_category, y = pct_DEGs, fill = tad_category)
) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(round(pct_DEGs, 1), "%\n(n=", n_DEGs, ")")),
    vjust = -0.3, size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = tad_colors) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.18))) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9)
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Percentage of DEGs at TAD boundaries",
    subtitle = "Random regions as background control",
    x        = "TAD boundary category",
    y        = "% DEGs"
  )

print(p_deg_tad)
ggsave(file.path(tad_out_dir, "tad_boundary_DEG_pct_barplot.pdf"),
       p_deg_tad, width = 9, height = 6)

cat("\n=== TAD BOUNDARY ANALYSIS COMPLETE ===\n")
```

```{r Master Gene Annotation Table}
cat("\n=== BUILDING MASTER GENE ANNOTATION TABLE ===\n\n")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Normalized counts (wide format: one column per sample)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
norm_counts <- as.data.frame(counts(dds, normalized = TRUE))
norm_counts$gene <- rownames(norm_counts)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. DEG info: one row per gene × contrast × direction
#    Use all_results (list of data frames from the contrasts loop)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
deg_info <- bind_rows(all_results) %>%
  select(gene, contrast, diffexpressed, log2FoldChange, lfc_shrunk, padj) %>%
  filter(diffexpressed != "NO") %>%          # keep only actual DEGs
  rename(
    DEG_direction  = diffexpressed,
    log2FC_raw     = log2FoldChange,
    log2FC_shrunk  = lfc_shrunk,
    DEG_padj       = padj
  )

# For genes that are DEG in more than one contrast, collapse into
# semicolon-separated strings so we end up with one row per gene
deg_collapsed <- deg_info %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(
    is_DEG        = TRUE,
    DEG_contrasts = paste(contrast,      collapse = ";"),
    DEG_direction = paste(DEG_direction, collapse = ";"),
    DEG_log2FC    = paste(round(log2FC_raw,    3), collapse = ";"),
    DEG_log2FC_sh = paste(round(log2FC_shrunk, 3), collapse = ";"),
    DEG_padj      = paste(formatC(DEG_padj, format = "e", digits = 2), collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Cluster membership (from kmeans clustering)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
cluster_info <- data.frame(
  gene    = names(clusters),
  cluster = as.integer(clusters)
)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Loop anchor membership
#    loop_data is the list built in "Loop Anchor Gene Analysis"
#    Each element holds $genes (character vector) and $type (specific/shared)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
loop_info <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(loop_data), function(nm) {
    data.frame(
      gene          = loop_data[[nm]]$genes,
      loop_category = nm,
      loop_type     = loop_data[[nm]]$type,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
) %>%
  # A gene can appear in multiple loop categories → collapse
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(
    loop_categories = paste(sort(unique(loop_category)), collapse = ";"),
    loop_types      = paste(sort(unique(loop_type)),     collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Compartment class
#    bin_gene_map was built in "Compartment intersection"
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
comp_info <- bin_gene_map %>%
  rename(gene = gene_name) %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(
    compartment_class = paste(sort(unique(as.character(switching))), collapse = ";"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Assemble master table
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
all_genes <- data.frame(gene = rownames(norm_counts), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

master_table <- all_genes %>%
  left_join(norm_counts,     by = "gene") %>%
  left_join(deg_collapsed,   by = "gene") %>%
  left_join(cluster_info,    by = "gene") %>%
  left_join(loop_info,       by = "gene") %>%
  left_join(comp_info,       by = "gene") %>%
  mutate(
    is_DEG = ifelse(is.na(is_DEG), FALSE, is_DEG)
  ) %>%
  # Reorder: gene | annotation cols | counts
  select(
    gene,
    is_DEG,
    DEG_contrasts, DEG_direction, DEG_log2FC, DEG_log2FC_sh, DEG_padj,
    cluster,
    loop_categories, loop_types,
    compartment_class,
    everything()
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(is_DEG), DEG_contrasts, gene)

cat(paste("Total genes in master table:", nrow(master_table), "\n"))
cat(paste("DEGs annotated:", sum(master_table$is_DEG), "\n"))
cat(paste("Genes with cluster assignment:", sum(!is.na(master_table$cluster)), "\n"))
cat(paste("Genes with loop annotation:", sum(!is.na(master_table$loop_categories)), "\n"))
cat(paste("Genes with compartment annotation:", sum(!is.na(master_table$compartment_class)), "\n\n"))

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Export
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
out_path <- file.path(output_dir, "master_gene_annotation_table.tsv")
write.table(
  master_table,
  out_path,
  sep       = "\t",
  row.names = FALSE,
  quote     = FALSE,
  na        = ""
)

cat(paste("Master table saved to:", out_path, "\n"))
cat("\nColumn legend:\n")
cat("  is_DEG          – TRUE if DEG in at least one contrast\n")
cat("  DEG_contrasts   – semicolon-separated list of contrasts where gene is DEG\n")
cat("  DEG_direction   – UP / DOWN per contrast (same order as DEG_contrasts)\n")
cat("  DEG_log2FC      – raw log2FC per contrast\n")
cat("  DEG_log2FC_sh   – ashr-shrunken log2FC per contrast\n")
cat("  DEG_padj        – adjusted p-value per contrast\n")
cat("  cluster         – k-means cluster (k=", optimal_k, "); NA if not a DEG\n", sep="")
cat("  loop_categories – loop condition(s) where gene's TSS overlaps an anchor\n")
cat("  loop_types      – specific / shared (mirrors loop_categories)\n")
cat("  compartment_class – A/B switching pattern (e.g. B_A_A = B in REH, A in EP1, A in Aro)\n")
cat("  remaining cols  – per-sample DESeq2 normalized counts\n")

cat("\n=== MASTER TABLE COMPLETE ===\n")
```
